source_row.society: Medical and Dental Defence Union of Scotland
source_row.extraction_instructions: Listing at /training-and-cpd/events (not the recon start_url) is a Sitecore search widget, 10 cards/page, 8 pages, ?page=N&orderby=date&ordertype=asc. Cards are <a class="result-item--event"> with title/summary/meta inside the anchor itself — the generic DOM walker misses these (digit right after /events/ fails its URL regex) so this source needs list_shells_override. Detail page has a .p--vacancy--sidebar-details fact list (Date/Availability/Training type/CPD hours|points) and plain-text "Course Fee: MDDUS member £X / Non-member £Y" pricing (no <table>). Gotcha: the structured Date field is wrong on some cloned recurring-course rows (same value repeated across 3 URLs) and the intro sentence is wrong on at least one other row — extractor cross-checks both against the URL's /events/<year>/<month>/ segments before trusting either.

spot_check.extractor_says: 2026-09-03 (resolved via URL+intro-sentence cross-check, matches this clone); pricing_tiers = [{'tier_label': 'MDDUS member', 'price_gbp': 0.0}]

spot_check.site_says: sidebar Date = 12 November 2026 (matches URL /2026/november/); intro sentence wrongly says 'Tuesday, 9 September'

concerns: Two independent per-row CMS date bugs observed live on the site (see extraction_instructions): a cloned-course template group all showing the same wrong sidebar Date, and at least one row with a copy-pasted wrong month in its intro sentence. The extractor cross-checks both fields against the URL's own /events/<year>/<month>/ segments and only accepts a day when one source's month matches the URL; if BOTH are wrong on some future row (not observed in the 6 detail pages + 71 listing cards checked by eye), that row is silently skipped rather than dated wrong — skip-over-guess was the deliberate choice per the brief ('never invent data').

Did not see a single in-person/hybrid event across all 8 listing pages (71 events, all 'Interactive Zoom courses') so event_format is hardcoded to 'online' with no venue/city/region path. If MDDUS ever runs an in-person course this extractor will still tag it online/no-venue — flagging in case a future audit run shows that.

CPD accreditation: only ever saw 'accredited by the Federation of the Royal Colleges of Physicians of the UK for N CPD credits' as the phrasing; cpd_accredited is keyed off that literal substring plus cpd_points being present. Not tested against a course with cpd_points but no accreditation phrase (didn't encounter one) — would currently mark cpd_accredited=False in that case, which seems like the right default but is unproven.

Ran the harness against the live browser (no --force-fallback path exists for this source — it's browser-first per the wave1d addendum, not http_fetch-based, so that flag doesn't exercise anything different here). Ran list_shells_override twice; identical 70-shell count both times.

71 total events on-site at test time; 1 dropped as a date-resolution failure would be silent by design, but none actually failed — all 71 resolved a date; 70 were >= today (2026-09-29), 1 was earlier today and excluded by the >= today filter, hence shells=70 not 71.
